receipt.scope: Isolated copied production source with intercepted public fixtures. No DB or hosted correctness claim.

scope: Production browser SECOND rapid offscreen pan return after a full viewport query-cache round trip; synthetic catalog735 and simulated SDK. Input uses provider API. DOM disappearance at returned target viewport, not physical-display flicker. 2000ms bounded observation after return, rAF blocked intervals are unobserved.

result.note: Transient intended pan update is separate; defect is >250ms zero-marker span after returning to a target known to have markers. Threshold frozen before v7 build; right-censored spans remain lower bounds.
